data.name: AION Mono Pro 17 grayscale monitor controller

specification.conversion: Four pixel codes map to four programmable values selected from a 16-level intensity range; custom controller plus 4-bit DAC and qualified linear video amplifier. CRT deflection and high-voltage electronics remain separate.
specification.qualification: Validate pixel-clock settling, grayscale distinguishability, geometry, corner focus, phosphor persistence and sync compatibility.
